name: Temnyy Bik Hory
source:
The story is about a girl who comes to the Carpathians and finds a new friend there. However, strange things happen around her.

[translated from [url=https://mjeighty.itch.io/darksideofthemountain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一个女孩来到喀尔巴阡山脉并在那里找到了一个新朋友。然而，她的周围却发生了奇怪的事情。
